entities.summary: Ivan Čiernik is a Slovak former professional ice hockey player. He last played for Eispiraten Crimmitschau of DEL2. He also previously played in the National Hockey League (NHL). Čiernik played a total of 89 games in the NHL for the Ottawa Senators and Washington Capitals.
